name: wildfire-datasets
title: Wildfire-related datasets
description: A catalog of public datasets relevant to wildfire risk, detection, impact, and response in the United States, with how each can be accessed and how often it changes.

resources.name: fire-datasets
resources.title: Fire datasets
resources.description: One row per dataset, with its access requirements, a landing page, and (where available) a direct link to example data.

fields.name: access_type
fields.title: Access type
fields.description: What is needed to retrieve the data: nothing ("No auth"), a free API key or account ("Free key"), a bulk download or analytic tool ("Bulk or analytic"), or archived static files ("Static files").

fields.name: name
fields.title: Name
fields.description: Name of the dataset or data source.

fields.name: description
fields.title: Description
fields.description: Short summary of what the dataset contains.

fields.name: data_velocity
fields.title: Data velocity
fields.description: How frequently the data changes: "high" for near-real-time or frequently updated feeds, "low" for periodic releases or historical archives.

fields.name: webpage
fields.title: Webpage
fields.description: Landing page or documentation for the dataset.

fields.name: example_data_url
fields.title: Example data URL
fields.description: Direct link to a sample file or API response, if one is available. Bracketed segments (e.g. [MAP_KEY]) are placeholders to fill in.
